## Sources screened without a strategy

- **TradingView Community Scripts** — NOT COLLECTED: robots.txt (fetched 2026-11-13) disallows /scripts/* and /script/* for AI agents (ClaudeBot, ChatGPT-User and others). The repository's Pine Script analyser (Trading Video Lab #pine) analyses source a person pastes; it is not a downloader. Paste open-source strategy scripts there to bring them into this workflow.
- **CME Group Education** — NOT COLLECTED: The site answered 403 and states that scripts, spiders and other automated access are prohibited by its Data Terms of Use. Not retried.
- **IBKR Campus (6 posts on gold/crypto read)** — NO STRATEGY: Market commentary, product lessons and research analyses (gold/silver ratio smoothing, gold vs bitcoin Kalman filter, XGBoost gold vs silver, crypto stat-arb feature ideas, a gold overlay on a 60/40 portfolio, bitcoin seasonality outlook): no entry/exit rules.
- **QuantConnect forum threads without a strategy** — NO STRATEGY: 17175 'Can I use Opening Range Breakout on XAUUSD?' (a question), 17990 gold futures after payrolls (an observation), 19666 BTC intraday systems (a discussion, no rules), 12962 and 13481 (questions without code).

## Paper-trading gate (all must hold)

1. implemented as published on the original market or its nearest data
2. no look-ahead found (freqtrade lookahead-analysis or our truncation test)
3. net positive in the development window
4. net positive out of sample
5. net positive out of sample at twice the costs
6. at least 30 out-of-sample trades
7. out-of-sample mean-trade t-stat >= 2.0
8. net positive out of sample on the second pair (crypto) or the other window (gold)
9. out-of-sample return above buy-and-hold scaled by the time in the market
